name: Basic Organometallic Chemistry
description: Organometallic chemistry of main-group, transition, and inner transition metals; synthesis and applications of organometallic reagents such as BuLi, Grignard, organoaluminum, and organozinc compounds. The 18-electron rule, bonding and IR characteristics of metal carbonyls, and coordination chemistry of phosphines and N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs). Interactions of alkenes, alkynes, carbenes, and carbynes with metal centers; hapticity concepts involving η²–η⁸ ligands. Fundamental organometallic reaction mechanisms including oxidative addition, reductive elimination, migratory insertions (1, 1- and 1, 2-), and β-hydride elimination. Substitution mechanisms, fluxional behavior, and hapticity changes in organometallic complexes. Organometallic clusters, C–H bond activation, and agostic/anagostic interactions. Homogeneous catalysis involving hydrogenation, hydroformylation, methanol carbonylation to acetic acid, and Wacker oxidation. Introduction to cross-coupling and olefin metathesis reactions, as well as olefin oligomerization and polymerization processes.
